name: needlepath
description: Sends large tool results through Needlepath context selection so Claude reads excerpts of the original text instead of all of it, never a rewrite. Fails open: on any problem Claude keeps the original output.

needlepath_api_key.title: Needlepath API key
needlepath_api_key.description: Don't have a key? Create an account at https://console.nextmoca.com, generate an API key, and enter it here.

needlepath_mode.title: Selection mode
needlepath_mode.description: Start in shadow, then use the Needlepath enable command after diagnostics pass.

needlepath_min_tokens.title: Minimum candidate tokens
needlepath_min_tokens.description: Do not call Needlepath for smaller tool results.

needlepath_max_context_tokens.title: Maximum selected tokens
needlepath_max_context_tokens.description: Maximum selectable context budget after mandatory output fields are reserved.

needlepath_timeout_ms.title: Selection timeout
needlepath_timeout_ms.description: Total sidecar and Needlepath deadline in milliseconds.

needlepath_telemetry.title: Metadata telemetry
needlepath_telemetry.description: Store and report selection metadata without prompts, tool content, or credentials.
